materialFinding.title: Rebind directories after callback-driven scans before exposing replica pathname
materialFinding.cause: recheck() performs source.recheck and root_binding before two physical captures with callback, but has no directory-link validation after those callbacks. A callback can rename/substitute owned output parent during the source scan, leaving source and replica FD contents/stats unchanged while returned state.path resolves elsewhere.
materialFinding.requiredRepair: After both same_entries captures, call state_->source.recheck() and state_->root_binding() without any callback afterward.
materialFinding.testIdea: Arm a callback for an existing capability recheck; rename output parent and substitute its original pathname during source scan, require refusal, restore original parent binding before explicit cleanup. No real private DB is needed.

otherGuardsReviewed: Nofollow directory FD chains and regular nlink1 files, SHA and full sampled file/directory metadata before/copy/after, bounded entry/bytes/depth/chunks, exclusive private700/600 replica, fsync and no shared inode.
Cleanup validates created inode identities and removes only its recorded entries via held FD; failures prevent completion.
RO invariant and cold readers accept only capability and use independent replicas; pre pair closes/cleans before originals are opened RWExisting, post readers after each RW scope.
Two retained NEXT600 file and directory fsync before Pair/application remain in original order; original sources never opened RW; typed recovery and full transition authority unchanged.
Tiny idle open writer conformance reads only separate replica; no concurrent-writing/quiescence or powerloss qualification claimed.
